concerns.text: Task T010 claims to satisfy FR‑001 (ingest pre‑trained LoRA adapters from the original LatentSkill repository) but downloads adapters from the proxy dataset `proxy_lora_dataset: mrm8488/peft-examples`. This substitutes the required data source with a different one without an explicit amendment, weakening FR‑001.

FR‑007 requires validation of the text‑weight alignment assumption via Pearson correlation between text‑space and weight‑space distances. The plan states that this will instead be validated against functional success‑rate (vs. zero‑shot), which changes the validation method and weakens FR‑007, yet the task still claims to compute the correlation.
